terms.definition: The muscular organ that pumps blood around the body.
terms.function: Double pump sending blood to lungs and body.
terms.whereItIs: In the chest, behind the breastbone.
terms.whyItMatters: It keeps oxygen and nutrients flowing to every cell.

terms.definition: One of the two upper chambers that receive blood.
terms.function: Collects blood before it moves to the ventricle.
terms.whereItIs: Top of the heart, one on each side.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the receiving room of the heart.

terms.definition: One of the two lower pumping chambers.
terms.function: Pumps blood out to the lungs or the body.
terms.whereItIs: Bottom of the heart, one on each side.
terms.whyItMatters: The ventricles do the actual pumping.

terms.definition: A flap in the heart that lets blood flow one way only.
terms.whereItIs: Between the atria and ventricles and in the big vessels.
terms.whyItMatters: They keep circulation moving in the right direction.

terms.definition: The biggest artery, carrying blood out to the body.
terms.function: Main highway out of the heart.
terms.whereItIs: Leaving the left ventricle and curving upward.
terms.whyItMatters: It distributes oxygen-rich blood to the whole body.
